headline.title: Honda and Acura dealers lose their ordering portal
headline.quip: Dealers couldn’t order parts or look up recalls, so for once nobody could tell you the part was on back order.
headline.summary: A cyber incident took Honda’s iN dealer portal offline in the US. Dealers couldn’t submit finance applications, order parts or check recalls. The portal came back, then went offline again.

reasons: Backfilled during setup and reviewed by the owner.
